final as (

with

src as (

    select
        location_id,
        data_date,
        load_ts,
        hourly

    from DEV.CHEDDR_WEDDR.stg__air_quality

),

ts_times_1 as (

    select distinct j.value::datetime as ts_time

    from src,
        lateral flatten(input => hourly:time) as j

),

ts_times_2 as (

    select
        ts_time,
        (row_number() over (order by ts_time asc) - 1) as ts_index

    from ts_times_1

),

flattened as (

    select
        f.location_id,
        tt.ts_time,
        j.key::varchar as field,
        k.value::float as value,
        f.data_date,
        f.load_ts

    from src as f,
        lateral flatten(input => hourly) as j,
            lateral flatten(input => j.value) as k
    inner join ts_times_2 as tt
        on k.index = tt.ts_index
    where field <> 'time'

)

select * from flattened


  -- this filter will only be applied on an incremental run
  -- (uses >= to include records arriving later on the same day as the last run of this model)
  where data_date >= (select coalesce(max(ts_time), '1900-01-01') from DEV.CHEDDR_WEDDR.fct__air_quality)
